But the sentence says "Various control interfaces, including ... haptic controllers [29, 13] ... are developed to build teleoperated systems." It cites [13] as a haptic controller. But "haptic controllers" specifically? The paper's haptic feedback module uses ERM actuators to provide tactile sensations, not to control. It is not a controller. The cited paper's system uses Vision Pro for control and haptic feedback for feedback. So citing it as a haptic controller is somewhat inaccurate. But is it "incorrect" or "unverifiable"? The cited text clearly describes haptic feedback, not haptic control. The claim that [13] is a haptic controller is not supported; it's about something else (teleoperation with haptic feedback). So status "incorrect" maybe.
